test_results.observation: Exact PostgreSQL retrieval returned only active Chunks from the authorized Workspace and pinned Embedding Configuration; historical, cross-Workspace and alternate-configuration sets were excluded.
Cosine similarity, the inclusive 0.65 boundary, candidate limit and deterministic similarity/document/ordinal/chunk ordering were verified.
Evidence selection assigned one outcome per candidate, removed strong adjacent overlap and enforced both five-Chunk and 3000-token limits.
The complete HTTP path returned an ANSWER with validated request-scoped aliases, first-marker citation order, server-resolved version-pinned metadata, bounded excerpts and an opaque trace ID.
No qualified evidence returned the application-owned REFUSAL contract, persisted the refusal trace and did not invoke GenerationProvider.
A valid structured provider refusal with qualified evidence produced the normalized application refusal and recorded completed generation.
Unknown, duplicate, missing and misordered Evidence Alias markers were rejected without repair; invalid generation was traced and mapped to HTTP 502 GENERATION_OUTPUT_INVALID.

Question Trace persistence captured retrieval, generation and validation provenance before response; a trace-store failure prevented answer delivery and no chain-of-thought field exists in the trace contract.
Workspace, active-set, historical-set and Embedding Configuration SQL filters remain verified after remediation.
Exact cosine scoring, inclusive threshold and deterministic candidate ordering remain verified.
Overlap, five-Chunk and 3000-token evidence bounds remain verified with one outcome per candidate.
Validated ANSWER responses retain ordered server-resolved Citation Projections and persisted trace IDs.
No-qualified-evidence Refusal is now verified at both application and HTTP seams with zero GenerationProvider calls.
Valid structured provider Refusal remains normalized and traced after remediation.
Invalid aliases and marker inconsistencies remain traced and mapped to HTTP 502 without repair retry.

All retrieved candidates, including below-threshold exclusions, now retain Chunk/Chunk Set/Embedding Set provenance; legacy migration rows are explicitly unrecorded and trace-store failure still prevents delivery.
